brief.goal: Bind event-config child action idempotency to the current planned action and Plan so fresh Jobs cannot collide with historical request hashes.

allowed_writes: Solution Design, Task, Context Manifest and current mechanism/data/lessons documents
existing event-config Plan-bound action propagation and idempotency construction
current Case fresh readonly recovery through the existing workbench command
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, automatic confirmations, retries and OAuth refresh
reuse or mutation of consumed Plan, confirmation, action or idempotency records
new API, Schema, View, Gate, Plan/action type or worker
persisting secrets or raw platform payloads/responses
validation_plan: cross-Job same-request idempotency and missing-binding regression smoke
event-config partial baseline and duplicate execution smoke
single-confirmation orchestrator, schema, security and runtime consistency checks
restart workbench and run only fresh readonly recovery for the current Case
stop_conditions: a database constraint change, history deletion or permission broadening would be required
a real platform write, automatic confirmation, retry or credential refresh would be required
the implementation requires a new public API, Gate, Plan or action type
